items: COMPACT POCKET PLANNER 2026-2027 OVERVIEW： Organize your year with ease using the POPRUN 6.5" x 3.5" pocket planner 2026-2027. Covering 12 full months from July 2026 to June 2027, this small planner is designed to fit perfectly into your purse, pocket, or bag. It’s the ultimate portable pocket calendar for managing appointments and tasks on the move without carrying a bulky notebook.

Monthly Calendar & Weekly Planner：This small academic planner features a clear weekly layout to help you master your time and organize your schedule in a compact view. Despite its size, it uses professional-grade 100gsm acid-free ivory paper—20% thicker than ordinary small calenders—ensuring excellent ink resistance and bleed-proof performance. Keep your on-the-go notes clean and professional.

EXTENSIVE PRODUCTIVITY PAGES & NOTE SECTIONS：Maximize your efficiency with the integrated organization system built into this pocket planner 2026-2027. Beyond daily tracking, it includes a Yearly Overview, Holiday & Calendar pages, Contact/Password sections, and Dotted Notes for quick ideas. This small planner acts as your personal command center, consolidating all vital information in one secure, pocket-sized place.

EXQUISITE DESIGN：Experience seamless navigation with features designed for a mobile lifestyle. This pocket calendar includes a flexible "TODAY" ruler, monthly tabs, and tear-off corners for instant access to the current day. The durable Hardcover also features a Pen Loop, dual bookmark ribbons, and a foldable paper pocket at the back to store receipts and cards safely while traveling.

MULTIPLE USER GROUPS & VERSATILE APPLICATIONS：Whether you are a student, a teacher, or a professional on the move, this small academic planner fits perfectly into your daily routine. Ideal for study planning, work management, or personal life organization, it is the ultimate portable companion to help you stay organized and productive through busy academic schedules, hectic workdays, and every detail of your daily life.
